# GitHub Copilot instructions

Shared repository instructions are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Read it and the
applicable nested `AGENTS.md` files before working on this repository. Keep
harness-independent guidance there, not in this file.

Repository skills are in [.agents/skills](../.agents/skills).

## Copilot code reviews

- Copilot code reviews are enabled for this repository.
- After creating a pull request, monitor build status and Copilot code review
  comments in parallel.
- Analyze Copilot code review comments and fix them when the suggested change
  makes sense.
- Always reply to Copilot code review comments. If a comment is addressed with a
  fix, resolve the comment after posting the reply.
